changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.16
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans selects its orphans with reapable(c), nexus.chunk_is_reapable: it now honours the 30 day grace window (counted from when the chunk last lost an owner row) and chooses its candidate set once, so the collision guard, the copy INSERT and the DELETE read the same set. Built on hygiene-005-1's body (origin-row sibling registration).

changeSet.author: nexus-wbfpw.16
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_bounded selects its victims and its remaining count with reapable(c), nexus.chunk_is_reapable, and its DELETE re-checks it on the target row. Built on hygiene-008-1's body (origin-row sibling registration), not catalog-037-1's.
